items.title: Bryce Young: Tosses two TDs in win over Ravens
items.text:
Young completed 22 of 30 passes for 254 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 35-33 win over Baltimore.

items.title: Geno Smith: Tosses three TDs in Week 11 win
items.text:
Smith completed 17 of 21 passes for 176 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers. He also rushed once for four yards.

items.title: Garrett Wilson: Team-high 39 receiving yards in win
items.text:

items.title: Kenny Gainwell: Records 59 total yards in loss
items.text:
Gainwell rushed four times for 16 yards and brought in four of five targets for 43 yards in the Buccaneers 31-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

items.title: Tetairoa McMillan: Finds end zone in win over Baltimore
items.text:
